bugs.title: Ascending price sort is reversed
steps: Choose Price: low to high under Sort by.

bugs.title: Negative quantities produce negative totals
steps: Set quantity to -2 and blur the field.
bugs.expected: Reject negative quantity; preserve the previous valid quantity.
bugs.actual: Quantity is -2, subtotal is -$28, and total is -$23.

bugs.title: Large lamp has missing content and an invalid price
bugs.expected: Product description remains visible; price is $69.
bugs.actual: Description becomes undefined and price becomes $NaN.

bugs.title: Remove does not remove a cart item
bugs.expected: The item disappears and totals update.
bugs.actual: A success message appears, but the item and totals remain.

bugs.title: Adding once inserts two units
steps: Click Add to cart once for any product.
bugs.actual: Two units are added, although the notification says one.

bugs.title: Empty checkout creates a successful order
steps: Fill all fields with fictional but valid details.
bugs.expected: Checkout is blocked until at least one item is in the cart.
bugs.actual: Confirmation reports success for an order with zero items and a $0 total.

bugs.title: Category filter leaves unrelated products visible
bugs.actual: All six products remain, including Home and Desk products.

bugs.title: Special-character search shows a failure page
bugs.expected: A normal results or no-results page.
bugs.actual: A simulated 500 Search failed page with a URIError stack trace. HTTP status remains 200.

bugs.title: SAVE10 adds a surcharge instead of a discount
bugs.actual: The page labels a $1.40 discount but adds it; total is $20.40.

bugs.title: Nimbus Mug image is missing
steps: Open the shop or Nimbus Mug details.
bugs.actual: The image request returns 404 and a broken image with alt text is visible.
